verdict.rationale: Restate persists state, invocation journals, and execution history (restate-docs-2, restate-docs-10, restate-docs-64-66), and offers self-hosted/BYOC deployment (restate-docs-14, restate-docs-70) which implies some infrastructure-level control, but the evidence pack contains no explicit documentation of data retention policies, TTL/expiration settings, or deletion/purge APIs for stored state or journals.
